title: California Condors Rebounded To 500
hook: California condors climbed from just 27 birds.
closing: Recovery works, but preventable poisoning can still erase decades of progress.
question: Should lead ammunition be restricted?

segments.say: California condors reached 500 birds. A species near extinction became a real recovery story.
The condor population passed 300 birds. Rebuilding a species takes decades of protection.
Lead poisoning causes 50% of wild condor deaths. One preventable threat still endangers the comeback.
